edges.mechanism: Cocoa contains caffeine and theobromine (methylxanthines); MAOI labeling warns that excessive chocolate/caffeine may cause hypertensive reactions.
edges.evidence: FDA phenelzine label dietary warning; no trial data for standardized low-caffeine extracts.

edges.mechanism: Label warns excessive caffeine and chocolate may cause hypertensive reactions with phenelzine.
Additive methylxanthine load (COSMOS extract ~50 mg theobromine + ~15 mg caffeine/d; cocoa foods more variable).
edges.evidence: Composition data from COSMOS and LactMed; acute RCT of cocoa flavanols plus 215 mg caffeine showed no cognitive interaction; no adverse-event interaction data.

edges.mechanism: Theoretical additive antiplatelet effect of cocoa flavanols/dark chocolate.
edges.evidence: Platelet-function changes in some small RCTs and an MA; 12-wk RCT up to 2000 mg/d showed no platelet change; no clinical bleeding reports found. Theoretical.

edges.mechanism: Theoretical additive inhibition of platelet aggregation.
edges.evidence: Acute dark chocolate inhibited collagen-induced aggregation (n=30 RCT); MA of RCTs reports platelet-function effects; not confirmed with chronic high-dose extract.

edges.mechanism: Small additive BP lowering via NO-mediated vasodilation, larger in hypertensive individuals.
edges.evidence: Cochrane and 2025 MA of RCTs (moderate certainty), effect ~2-6 mmHg SBP; no interaction case reports.

edges.mechanism: Flavanols may improve insulin sensitivity (HOMA-IR) -- theoretical additive glucose lowering.
edges.evidence: MA of 19 RCTs (biomarkers); COSMOS showed no effect on T2D incidence; hypoglycemia not reported.

edges.mechanism: No cognitive synergy; combination associated with relative decline in executive function and small glucose rise in one RCT.
edges.evidence: Single 12-month RCT (CANN, n=259) in older adults with memory complaints.
COSMOS excluded extreme caffeine sensitivity; composition data.

edges.mechanism: Cocoa food products may carry lead and cadmium (higher in high-%-cocoa products and some cocoa powders); developmental toxicity concern.
edges.evidence: FDA retail survey and Consumer Reports testing of foods; no data for standardized extract capsules.

edges.mechanism: Lead/cadmium in cocoa foods; neurodevelopmental risk.
edges.evidence: FDA retail survey; Consumer Reports testing.

edges.mechanism: Chocolate is a self-reported trigger for some people; standardized extract associated with fewer self-reported migraines in COSMOS.
edges.evidence: Observational MA of trigger prevalence (13.9%, very heterogeneous) vs RCT secondary data (HR 0.85).

edges.mechanism: Methylxanthines pass into breast milk; extreme intakes may affect infant.
Greater BP reduction when baseline BP is elevated.
edges.evidence: Cochrane subgroup (-4 mmHg SBP) and 2025 MA (-5.9 mmHg office SBP); moderate certainty; COSMOS null for incident hypertension overall.
